title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING AND DELINEATING THE CUYO PORT ZONE UNDER THE ADMINISTRATIVE JURISDICTION OF THE PHILIPPINE PORTS

text.en:
The territorial jurisdiction of the port of Cuyo situated in
Barangay Tenga-Tenga, Municipality of Cuyo, Province of Palawan is hereby
declared, expanded, and delineated particularly described as follows:
"Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, located at the
present main gate of the Cuyo port, thence going due East parallel to
point 2 at a distance of 35.30 meters, thence going due South
parallel to point 3 at a distance of 557.80 meters, thence going due
West parallel to point 4 at a distance of 911.50 meters, thence going
due North parallel to point 5 at a distance of 803.00 meters, thence
going due East parallel to point 6 at a distance of 850.00 meters,
thence going due South diagonal with Bearing S 26.5 E to point 7 at
• a distance of 80.00 meters, thence going due South parallel to point
8 at a distance of 165.00 meters, thence going due West diagonal
with Bearing S 21.5'W to point 9 at a distance of 3.00 meters, thence
PGMA Hologram # 46241

due South parallel to point of beginning at a distance 7.86 meters,
containing an area of Seven Hundred Twenty Two thousand Two
Hundred Sixty point Sixty square meters (722,260.60 sq.m.). All
points referred to are indicated on the plan.

The Cuyo port as defined, expanded and delineated is
hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports
Authority, which shall, consistent with the regional industrial plans of the
government, implement program in the proper zoning, planning, development
and utilization of the ports.

All orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby amended, repealed
or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd
Our Lord Two Thousand and Eight.
day of October, in the year of
flair M. Reep
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
